amendment.limitations: Post-inspection evidence amendment is development research. Known zero evaluation enactments cannot establish discrimination or generalization. Calendar package history supports bounded availability, not independently archived historical byte identity. Automated family review does not satisfy pending human audits.

Verify introduction from official introduction action independently of issue/referral date

design_status: Evidence-amended fixed-sample development study after inspecting v1 blockers and class counts; not a protected holdout
family_audit: Conservative union of official related-bill links and identical normalized introduced titles across sampled bills. Automated, not exhaustive manual provision lineage; residual family leakage remains a limitation.
feature_scope: Version existence and procedural stage only; no retrospective summaries, topics, current sponsor counts, modern embeddings, or outcome text in model features. Counts are published versions, not legislative action counts.
features: days since latest available version capped at 730 / 730
versions available in last 30 days capped at 10 / 10
interpretation: Original seeded100 fixed denominator; evidence-amended development study after v1 blockers and class counts observed. No replacement, no tuning or promotion. Separate publication-version study does not satisfy human/action-history audit. Zero evaluation enactments must be explicit alongside any scores; lower loss cannot validate identifying successful bills.
introduction_audit: Apply identically to all100 selected bills: verify exact official introduced-version package identity; require a unique introduction action date in official MODS bill actions matching BILLSTATUS introducedDate, and issue date on/after introduction. Distinct later referral/publication dates are preserved. Missing or conflicting introduction action blocks source audit. Retain separate original publication availability rule; no backdating. Record mismatches and reconciliation evidence, including118-H.R.5925, without bill-specific exceptions.
no_adaptation: No replacing excluded bills, changing sample boundaries, tuning features/hyperparameters, or selecting another checkpoint after scores. Any failed required audit blocks scoring. Final-calendar completeness, exact census crosscheck and historical availability must pass before fitting. Frozen v1 remains unchanged; no automatic live-model promotion.
primary_metric: Paired Brier difference: candidate minus baseline; negative favors candidate
publication_audit: GovInfo MODS identity/dateIssued plus successful PREMIS Ingestion, ACP Creation and Parsing; availability is the latest of those first-event dates and MODS dateIngested, at end of day plus one day. No bill-status action date is used as publication proof. Current rendition bytes are not claimed identical to historical bytes.
target: Own-bill public-law enactment before the constitutional end of its Congress
test_labels: Complete National Archives 118th public-law lists (274 laws), cross-checked against each sampled bill's official BILLSTATUS public-law references. Test outcomes never enter fitting.
training: Use earlier-Congress eligible snapshots only, remove all identified test-family overlap and retain lexicographically first training bill per family. Fit preprocessing on training rows. Minimum 20 families and both labels.
training_labels: 114th complete NARA census (329) crosschecked against unchanged STATUTE-129/130 provenance. 116th complete NARA census (344) crosschecked one-to-one by law number and originating bill against final House calendar CCAL-116hcal-S2 PUBLIC LAWS section (part7). Audit exact official package identity, final-calendar status, PDF rendition and conservative preservation availability before the earliest evaluation checkpoint. The calendar establishes complete membership/closure but does not establish exact enactment dates. Every sampled116 positive additionally requires an official dated law source, exact bill/law identity and enactment date agreeing with NARA, with audited availability before the earliest evaluation checkpoint. Missing, duplicate, ambiguous or conflicting membership/date evidence, or late/missing provenance, blocks scoring. Maintain original already-enacted and ambiguous end-of-Congress-date exclusions. All344 individual slip-law audits are diagnostics, not the claimed early complete source; PL116-283 has late2025 package availability and cannot establish an early date for any sampled bill.
uncertainty: 2000 test-family cluster bootstrap replicates, seed 20261024; conditional on fitted model, not Congress-level or training-sample uncertainty
